caption: The drawing depicts an elaborate historical dress, likely from the 18th century, shown on a headless mannequin. The dress is light in color, predominantly white or ivory, with detailed floral embroidery in pink, green, yellow, and blue hues. The dress features a fitted bodice with a low, wide neckline edged with a ruffled trim and additional lace accents at the cuffs of the long sleeves. The bodice extends into a full, floor-length skirt with wide panniers at the hips, giving the skirt a dramatic outward shape. The skirt is adorned with intricate floral patterns and decorative borders that follow a wavy line along the edges. The front apron of the skirt displays a collection of flowers in a bouquet motif and is similarly embellished with coordinating embroidery and pale blue trim near the hem. A smaller, simplified outline sketch of the dress's back view appears in the upper right corner, showing the garment’s silhouette, the fitted back, and additional lace trim. The drawing is rendered in fine lines with delicate washes of color to highlight the embroidery and ornamental details.
title: Dress
